99	// NewWithClient creates an Agent with a pre-configured Anthropic client (for testing).
100	func NewWithClient(client *anthropic.Client, sonarrClient sonarr.Client, radarrClient radarr.Client, prowlarrClient prowlarr.Client, overseerrClient overseerr.Client, nb notebook.Notebook, weatherClient *weather.Client, model string, maxTokens int, logger *slog.Logger, limiter *RateLimiter) *Agent {
101		return &Agent{
102			client:    client,
103			sonarr:    sonarrClient,
104			radarr:    radarrClient,
105			prowlarr:  prowlarrClient,
106			overseerr: overseerrClient,
107			notebook:  nb,
108			weather:   weatherClient,
109			model:     model,
110			maxTok:    int64(maxTokens),
111			logger:    logger,
112			limiter:   limiter,
113		}
114	}

116	// requestIDKey is the context key for the per-request identifier used in audit logs.
117	type requestIDKey struct{}
118	
119	// WithRequestID returns a child context carrying the given request ID.
120	func WithRequestID(ctx context.Context, id string) context.Context {
121		return context.WithValue(ctx, requestIDKey{}, id)
122	}
123	
124	func requestID(ctx context.Context) string {
125		if v, ok := ctx.Value(requestIDKey{}).(string); ok {
126			return v
127		}
128		return ""
129	}
130	
131	// buildSystemPrompt returns the system prompt with pinned notebook notes appended.
132	func (a *Agent) buildSystemPrompt(ctx context.Context) string {
133		dateLine := fmt.Sprintf("Today's date is %s.", time.Now().Format("2006-01-02"))
134	
135		var locationLine string
136		if a.weather != nil {
137			if cond := a.weather.Current(ctx); cond != nil {
138				locationLine = fmt.Sprintf("Current location: %s. Weather: %.0f°C, %s.", a.weather.Location(), cond.Temperature, cond.Description)
139			} else {
140				locationLine = fmt.Sprintf("Current location: %s.", a.weather.Location())
141			}
142		}
143	
144		var prompt string
145		if locationLine != "" {
146			prompt = fmt.Sprintf("%s\n%s\n\n%s", dateLine, locationLine, systemPrompt)
147		} else {
148			prompt = fmt.Sprintf("%s\n\n%s", dateLine, systemPrompt)
149		}
150	
151		if a.notebook == nil {
152			return prompt
153		}
154	
155		pinned, err := a.notebook.Pinned(ctx)
156		if err != nil {
157			a.logger.Warn("failed to load pinned notes", "error", err)
158			return prompt
159		}
160		if len(pinned) == 0 {
161			return prompt
162		}
163	
164		var sb strings.Builder
165		sb.WriteString(prompt)
166		sb.WriteString("\n\n## Notebook (always loaded)\n")
167		for _, n := range pinned {
168			sb.WriteString("### ")
169			sb.WriteString(n.Title)
170			sb.WriteString("\n")
171			sb.WriteString(n.Content)
172			sb.WriteString("\n")
173		}
174		return sb.String()
175	}
176	
177	// Process runs the agentic tool-use loop for a user message and returns the final text response.
178	// History turns are prepended to provide conversational context.
179	func (a *Agent) Process(ctx context.Context, userMessage string, history []Turn) (string, error) {
180		tools := toolDefinitions()
181	
182		var messages []anthropic.MessageParam
183		for _, t := range history {
184			switch t.Role {
185			case "user":
186				messages = append(messages, anthropic.NewUserMessage(anthropic.NewTextBlock(t.Content)))
187			case "assistant":
188				messages = append(messages, anthropic.NewAssistantMessage(anthropic.NewTextBlock(t.Content)))
189			}
190		}
191		messages = append(messages, anthropic.NewUserMessage(anthropic.NewTextBlock(userMessage)))
192	
193		if a.limiter != nil {
194			a.limiter.Reset()
195		}
196	
197		reqID := requestID(ctx)
198		sysPrompt := a.buildSystemPrompt(ctx)
199	
200		for round := range maxToolRounds {
201			resp, err := a.client.Messages.New(ctx, anthropic.MessageNewParams{
202				Model:     anthropic.Model(a.model),
203				MaxTokens: a.maxTok,
204				System: []anthropic.TextBlockParam{
205					{Text: sysPrompt},
206				},
207				Messages: messages,
208				Tools:    tools,
209			})
210			if err != nil {
211				return "", fmt.Errorf("claude API call: %w", err)
212			}
213	
214			// Collect tool uses from the response
215			var toolResults []anthropic.ContentBlockParamUnion
216			var textResponse string
217	
218			for _, block := range resp.Content {
219				switch v := block.AsAny().(type) {
220				case anthropic.TextBlock:
221					textResponse += v.Text
222				case anthropic.ToolUseBlock:
223					tr := a.executeToolWithAudit(ctx, v.Name, v.Input, round, reqID)
224					toolResults = append(toolResults, anthropic.NewToolResultBlock(v.ID, tr.Marshal(), !tr.Success))
225				}
226			}
227	
228			// If no tool calls, we're done
229			if len(toolResults) == 0 {
230				return textResponse, nil
231			}
232	
233			// Add assistant response and tool results to conversation
234			messages = append(messages, resp.ToParam())
235			messages = append(messages, anthropic.NewUserMessage(toolResults...))
236		}
237	
238		return "", fmt.Errorf("exceeded maximum tool rounds (%d)", maxToolRounds)
239	}
240	
241	// executeToolWithAudit wraps tool dispatch with rate limiting and audit logging.
242	func (a *Agent) executeToolWithAudit(ctx context.Context, name string, rawInput json.RawMessage, round int, reqID string) ToolResult {
243		// Audit log: invocation
244		a.logger.Info("tool invocation",
245			"tool", name,
246			"input", sanitizeInput(rawInput),
247			"round", round,
248			"request_id", reqID,
249		)
250	
251		// Rate limit check
252		if a.limiter != nil {
253			if err := a.limiter.Allow(name, IsMutative(name), IsDestructive(name)); err != nil {
254				a.logger.Warn("tool rate limited",
255					"tool", name,
256					"error", err,
257					"round", round,
258					"request_id", reqID,
259				)
260				return errorResult("rate_limited", err.Error(), true)
261			}
262		}
263	
264		start := time.Now()
265		result := a.dispatchTool(ctx, name, rawInput)
266		duration := time.Since(start)
267	
268		// Audit log: result
269		a.logger.Info("tool result",
270			"tool", name,
271			"success", result.Success,
272			"error_kind", result.ErrorKind,
273			"duration_ms", duration.Milliseconds(),
274			"round", round,
275			"request_id", reqID,
276		)
277	
278		return result
279	}
280	
281	// sanitizeInput returns a string summary of tool input suitable for logging.
282	// It strips any field whose key contains sensitive substrings to avoid leaking credentials.
283	func sanitizeInput(raw json.RawMessage) string {
284		var m map[string]any
285		if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
286			return "<invalid json>"
287		}
288		for k := range m {
289			lowerK := strings.ToLower(k)
290			if strings.Contains(lowerK, "key") || strings.Contains(lowerK, "secret") || strings.Contains(lowerK, "password") || strings.Contains(lowerK, "token") {
291				m[k] = "REDACTED"
292			}
293		}
294		out, err := json.Marshal(m)
295		if err != nil {
296			return "<failed to sanitize json>"
297		}
298		return string(out)
299	}
300	
301	// dispatchTool executes a tool call and returns a structured ToolResult.
302	// Errors are first-class: classification and retryability are encoded into
303	// the result so the agent loop can surface them to the model.
304	func (a *Agent) dispatchTool(ctx context.Context, name string, rawInput json.RawMessage) ToolResult {
305		if result, handled := a.dispatchSonarr(ctx, name, rawInput); handled {
306			return result
307		}
308		if result, handled := a.dispatchRadarr(ctx, name, rawInput); handled {
309			return result
310		}
311		if result, handled := a.dispatchProwlarr(ctx, name, rawInput); handled {
312			return result
313		}
314		if result, handled := a.dispatchOverseerr(ctx, name, rawInput); handled {
315			return result
316		}
317		if result, handled := a.dispatchNotebook(ctx, name, rawInput); handled {
318			return result
319		}
320		return errorResult("invalid_input", "unknown tool: "+name, false)
321	}
322	
323	// findIndexer fetches the indexer list from Prowlarr and returns the indexer with the given ID.
324	// On failure, it returns a non-nil ToolResult describing the error.
325	func (a *Agent) findIndexer(ctx context.Context, id int) (*prowlarr.Indexer, *ToolResult) {
326		indexers, err := a.prowlarr.ListIndexers(ctx)
327		if err != nil {
328			r := errorResultFromErr(err)
329			return nil, &r
330		}
331		for i := range indexers {
332			if indexers[i].ID == id {
333				return &indexers[i], nil
334			}
335		}
336		r := errorResult("not_found", fmt.Sprintf("indexer %d not found", id), false)
337		return nil, &r
338	}
339	
340	// marshalResult JSON-encodes a tool's success payload, returning a wrapped
341	// ToolResult with classified marshal errors on failure.
342	func marshalResult(result any) ToolResult {
343		data, err := json.Marshal(result)
344		if err != nil {
345			return errorResult("decode", "failed to marshal result: "+err.Error(), false)
346		}
347		return successResult(string(data))
348	}
